global_dod: No screen relies on placeholder factual data presented as real
Every external fact has source_id, fetched_at/verified_at, rights status, and confidence
Every route has loading, empty, error, unauthorized, stale-data and mobile states where relevant
Every user write has authentication/authorization and audit logging where risk warrants it
Every money flow has idempotency, reconciliation path, receipt behavior, failure recovery, and restricted-fund handling
Every map/location record preserves provider IDs and provenance
Google-derived content follows Google Maps Platform terms and storage/display restrictions
Permit/legal outputs identify jurisdiction, official source, effective/verified date, and professional-confirmation status
Religious normative claims are separated from architectural/historic facts and require appropriate review
Accessibility tested keyboard/screen reader/contrast/touch target/responsive
Security review covers auth, RBAC, secrets, uploads, payment webhooks, PII, audit logs, backups, rate limiting
SEO routes have canonical URL, metadata, structured data where valid, sitemap inclusion, noindex logic for thin/private pages
Analytics events contain no unnecessary sensitive personal data
Automated tests cover critical calculators, money, permissions, data freshness and dedupe
Database migrations are reversible or documented with rollback/forward-fix strategy
Observability includes error tracking, logs, uptime, job failures, webhook failures, ingestion failures
Backup/restore tested
Production environment has separate secrets/keys and least privilege
User-generated mosque edits have moderation/dispute/claim process
Content copyright/license state prevents unauthorized media redistribution

feature_dod_template.spec: purpose, user story, inputs, outputs, states, permissions, data dependencies
feature_dod_template.backend: schema, validation, auth, audit, rate limits
feature_dod_template.seo: indexing decision, metadata, schema, internal links

hard_release_gates: Payments reconciled in sandbox and production smoke test
Google/OSM attribution and licensing review complete
At least one launch jurisdiction regulatory pack reviewed by qualified local professional
Emergency/security features clearly distinguish planning tools from emergency-service guarantees
No AI-generated construction media labeled as real construction evidence
